services.heading: A clearer way into your research.

items.title: Publication & proposal visuals
items.body: Figures, journal cover artwork, and grant visuals that give your research a clear visual story.

items.title: Research & instrument visuals
items.body: Make structures, optical systems, and experimental hardware easier to understand.

items.title: Animation & custom work
items.body: Explore motion, technical explainers, and ideas that need a different visual approach.

items.title: Talk through the science
items.body: Bring an idea, paper, or rough sketch. We can explore the message and who needs to understand it.

items.title: Agree on a direction
items.body: We define the visual, scope, timeline, and quote together before any project begins.

items.title: Create and refine
items.body: I build the visual and share progress, with time for your feedback and scientific review.

items.question: Is the first chat free?
items.answer: Yes. The first conversation is a chance to discuss your science, explore ideas, and see whether working together makes sense. There is no obligation to start a project.

items.question: Do I need a finished brief?
items.answer: No. An idea, paper, sketch, or description of what you want to communicate is enough to start talking.

items.question: Can we work within an academic budget?
items.answer: Tell me what you need and the budget you are working with. We can discuss a focused scope for a student project, paper, proposal, or laboratory.

items.question: Can we discuss unpublished research?
items.answer: Yes. We can agree on confidentiality and any embargo requirements before you share sensitive material.

items.question: What happens after the conversation?
items.answer: If we decide to move forward, you receive a written quote with the scope, deliverables, timeline, revisions, and usage rights before work begins.

closing.heading: Tell me what you’re working on.
closing.body: You know the science. I can help find the visual that makes people want to understand it. Let’s start with a free conversation.
